Court Extends Judicial Custody for Giribala Singh and Samarth in Twisha Case

Giribala Singh and Samarth, involved in the Twisha case, have had their judicial custody extended. They will remain in jail until July 14, with their next court appearance scheduled for June 30. The CBI may present new evidence during this period.
